Agent Name: WebSurfer
Step Number: 1
Reason for Mistake: WebSurfer made an error in Step 1 by failing to resolve conflicting information effectively or cross-check sources properly. It encountered a snippet showing "United Kingdom" as the country of origin for "In My Skin," despite this being inconsistent with other authoritative sources such as Wikipedia and Unifrance, which confirm the film is French. The agent should have been more diligent in verifying this information across reliable databases instead of relying on potentially incorrect search snippet data.
